name: rasu
description: Make pictures and video with Rasu AI: one-off images and clips shown in Rasu AI's own panel, review notes pinned on a video, and films directed shot by shot with consistent characters.

interface.longDescription: Make any picture or clip, restyle a photo, try four variations, or direct a whole film with the same characters from shot to shot. Results open in Rasu AI's own panel in the chat, where you pick a take or pin review notes on a video.
defaultPrompt: Make four variations of this photo as a 1980s film still
Turn my product shot into an 8-second video ad
Plan the opening sequence of my short film about a lighthouse keeper
